remarks: Incredible Rowayton Village Waterfront rental on 5 Mile River. This 3,000SF apartment has it all; direct waterfront, beautiful views, totally renovated w character details, kitchen with stone counters, stainless appliances, formal living w fireplace, large dining room, primary suite with lots of closet space and spacious bath, library/office, three season porch with views of the Five Mile River, two additional bedrooms, renovated hall bath, laundry room and 2 outdoor decks; one on the main level and a second deck on the rooftop! There is one off street parking space and all Rowayton amenities: beach, restaurants at your door step, library, water activities and so much more . Don't miss it!
